catalogue: AllWISE (CDS VizieR II/328/allwise; IRSA CatWISE TAP was unavailable)
method: each catalogue position (epoch 2010.5589) moved in a straight line with its proper motion (stored as arcsec/yr, applied as mas/yr) to the frame's MJD; sources without proper motion stay at their 2010.5589 position
pixel_convention: PNG pixels: x to the right (west), y down (south), 0 = centre of the first pixel
target_match_rule: the IR source nearest the grid centre at 2026.0, if within 3.0″
data_credit: AllWISE (Cutri et al.), via CDS VizieR
